findings.rootCause: LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence gated the STORAGE_SUMMARY candidate on `statistics == null` (:162), the exact candidate on `statistics != null` (:269) and filter/finite-filter routing on `mappedStatisticsOwnPlanning()` = `statistics != null && mode != OFF` (:317). All three are mode-blind on service *existence*, so SHADOW (observation-only by contract) removed the storage-summary, exact and snapshot filter evidence that OFF mode provides, changing plans.
findings.change: Introduced LmdbFrontierLeafAnswer.answered(mode, estimate) = AUTHORITATIVE && fallbackReason == NONE && finite point, and `authoritative()` = statistics != null && mode == AUTHORITATIVE. Storage-summary gate is now `cardinalities != null && !frontierAnswered`; exactCandidate is gated on `frontierLeafAnswered(pattern)` (short-circuits to false outside AUTHORITATIVE, so SHADOW does not re-probe); filterEvidence/finiteFilterRelation/finiteFilterDomain route to mapped Frontier filters only when authoritative(). The SHADOW observation call to estimateLeafCurrent is retained (verified once per leaf). Sound because SHADOW never contributed evidence before; it now yields exactly the OFF evidence plus observation. RESUMED SESSION (critique issue[3], major): two further mode-blind gates were fixed the same way. (a) LmdbEstimatorRuntime.patternFilterPass passed `statistics != null && mode != OFF` as mappedStatisticsOwnPlanning to LmdbFilterPassSelection.mappedOrBestAvailable, so SHADOW returned only the mapped fallback (HEURISTIC) and suppressed the snapshot/learned/sampled filter-pass evidence OFF selects; it now requires AUTHORITATIVE. (b) LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.describePackedDistinctCursorSkip allowed the bounded LMDB distinct probe only when `statistics == null`; it now uses the new LmdbFrontierLeafAnswer.ready(mode, service) (AUTHORITATIVE && status READY && fallbackReason NONE) so SHADOW and every Frontier-declined AUTHORITATIVE state probe exactly as OFF does, while a READY authoritative Frontier still never samples LMDB (guarded by readyAuthoritativeFrontierNeverProbesLmdbForDistinctCursorSkip). (c) A guard test through LmdbPackedCostModel.estimateRows shows SHADOW packed leaves now carry the storage rows (the critique's '1-row SHADOW packed leaves' point), already fixed by the b1 resolver change.

RESUMED SESSION (critique issue[2], major): design part (5) was reverted on the critique's evidence. LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRows is consumed only by LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteProbeRows (:3516/:3592), whose FiniteLookupEstimate is stamped `finite_binding_probe` + EvidenceGuarantee.DATABASE_EXACT (:387-388); returning the bounded page estimate there would certify sampled counts (including sampled zeros) as exact in every cold/stale AUTHORITATIVE window (REVIEW 3.10 widened). The method now returns Double.NaN when Frontier is AUTHORITATIVE and declined (no finite lookup, as before b1); the 1-row fix is unaffected because those leaves are planned through legacyEstimateRows -> conventionalStatementPatternRows -> the resolver, which now carries the STORAGE_SUMMARY candidate. findings.rootCause: LmdbSailStore.refreshFrontierStatisticsDelta mapped every delta failure except CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE to RETRY (envelope 'exceeds its persistent envelope' MEMORY_PRESSURE, layer limit, dimension-mismatch IOException from FrontierOmniDeltaBuilder), and runScheduledFrontierRebuild returned on RETRY before the base-rebuild branch while the finally block rescheduled every 1 s, so a deterministic failure repeated forever; nothing triggered a base rebuild before the delta tier hit its hard ceiling (disk/16), and -Xmx drift changed the Omni cellCount so every delta failed with a dimension mismatch after restart (confirmed at 16 MiB and the 512 MiB default: stall after 112,000 inserts).
findings.change: (Work done in the interrupted b2 session in this worktree; verified green in this session.) (1) FrontierStatisticsException gained a `permanent` flag + requiresBaseRebuild() (existing ctors default to transient; static permanent()/transientFailure() factories). FrontierStatisticsDeltaBuilder marks the envelope, layer-limit and dimension-overflow throws permanent; FrontierOmniDeltaBuilder throws a permanent FrontierStatisticsException(MEMORY_PRESSURE) instead of a plain IOException on dimension mismatch (critique issue[9]: MEMORY_PRESSURE, not SHARD_CORRUPT). (2) LmdbSailStore.classifyDeltaFailure: permanent or CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE -> BASE_REBUILD_REQUIRED at once; transient failures RETRY up to FRONTIER_MAX_TRANSIENT_DELTA_FAILURES=8 for the same covered sequence, then escalate with one WARN. (3) Insertion-debt trigger frontierBaseRefreshOverdue(status): after a SUCCESSFUL delta publish (critique issue[5]: never before publishing, so deltas keep flowing while the rebuild is pending), a delta tier >= 0.75 * deltaAndManifestBudgetBytes (or deleteDebt >= 0.10, or a dimension mismatch flagged at open via frontierOmniDimensionsDiffer/LmdbStatisticsService.currentManifest()) requests a base rebuild; the same predicate stops the rebuild-abort shortcut from skipping an overdue base. The pure decision logic lives in the new package-private FrontierRebuildSchedulePolicy (unit-tested).

findings.change: (b2 session work, verified here.) Debounce-with-deadline: frontierBaseRebuildPending/frontierBaseRebuildPendingSinceNanos are set when a base rebuild is first found required and cleared by clearFrontierBaseRebuildPending() after a successful publish or an equivalent-generation abort. FrontierRebuildSchedulePolicy.shouldStartBaseRebuild(now, lastRequest, pending, pendingSince, quietNanos, maxDeferralNanos) starts the rebuild when the 1 s quiet period elapsed OR the pending rebuild has waited FRONTIER_REBUILD_MAX_DEFERRAL_NANOS = 5 s; the storeTxnStarted guard is unchanged. Deltas keep publishing while the base rebuild is pending (the old code returned on RETRY before reaching the rebuild branch). The secondary mapped/scalar flip (mappedStatisticsReady ignoring a complete in-memory tail) is deliberately deferred as designed.
